name: Binance MCP Server
description: Enables AI agents to perform cryptocurrency trading operations on Binance exchange through 30 comprehensive tools supporting spot trading, futures contracts, options, account management, market data analysis, and risk control features. Provides enterprise-grade security with local encrypted API key storage and supports multiple account types with sandbox environment testing.
